name: Plague Inc: The Cure
description: WHO-advised pandemic response strategy game by Ndemic Creations, released as an expansion to the Plague Inc franchise. Players take on the role of a global health organization managing disease control efforts including research funding, travel restrictions, healthcare system support, and public communication. Features emergent epidemiological dynamics where player decisions interact with modeled disease spread, social behavior, and healthcare capacity. Used for public health education and pandemic preparedness awareness.
general_score_metric: scenario outcome / scenario_success_rate (outcome-based: containment success, deaths avoided, time-to-control)
reputation: Commercially successful WHO-advised pandemic response game; notable for educational use during COVID-19
notes: Released November 2020 in direct response to the COVID-19 pandemic. Available on mobile (iOS/Android) and PC. Developed in consultation with WHO and other public health experts. Earlier Plague Inc. game sold over 160 million copies; The Cure reframes the mechanics as pandemic defense.
